## Density

**Fit more on screen in the apps you pick**, like Android's display size setting. Lists, feeds and pages show more, while the status bar and keyboard stay as they are.

- **Simple:** in Settings → Density, set the **Amount** (0 is normal, 30 fits the most), then switch it on for the apps you want.
- **Looks stock:** the keyboard and status bar are untouched, and text stays sharp.
- **Light:** apps you don't switch on load nothing extra.
- Changed something? Tap **Apply Changes**. It closes the apps you changed and resprings.

- **Out of beta**, for iOS 15–18.
- **Face ID iPhones:** chat bars and text boxes no longer tuck under the keyboard in any app (Reddit, Swiftgram and others). The strip below the keys (globe, dictation) is now counted at the right size everywhere.
- **Rotation and split screen:** apps fill their space when they rotate or when a split-screen tweak resizes them, instead of shrinking.
- **Since the betas:** chat boxes stay above the keyboard in Messages, Telegram, WhatsApp, Discord, Reddit and more, on iOS 15, 16, 17 and 18.

- **iOS 15 to 18.** Rootless jailbreaks. A RootHide version comes with the next update.
- If it ever sends your phone to Safe Mode, open Sileo (it still works there) and uninstall it. Then [tell me](https://github.com/Jond-ie/repo/issues).

- If an app looks wrong, switch Density off for it and [tell me](https://github.com/Jond-ie/repo/issues). Games haven't been tested.
- Needs **AltList** and **PreferenceLoader**. Sileo installs them for you.
Written from scratch by **Jond-ie**. Inspired by Android's display size (DPI) setting.
